facts.decision: Secretary of State; Historic England advises
facts.guard: SMC and planning permission are distinct

scope_guards: NHLE list entries and map-search results must be matched to the exact asset and current designation.
Listed Building Consent and ordinary planning permission remain distinct.
Scheduled Monument Consent is a separate Secretary of State consent route.
A list description is not a comprehensive condition survey or exact curtilage determination.
Heritage at Risk status is management evidence and not proof of title, vacancy or development outcome.
Designation does not create public access rights or alter freehold title by itself.
Consent applications, advice and pre-application engagement are not consent grants.
No score or promotion is written without exact asset boundary, significance, consent, condition and planning evidence.
